_comment: ElevenLabs. Set Endpoint to https://api.elevenlabs.io and put the key in the ElevenLabs box under Voice — it is sent as xi-api-key, not as a bearer token, and it is a separate field from the TTS server key so a station can run both. The voice goes in the URL rather than the body, which is what {voice} is for; use an ElevenLabs voice id (the Voice dropdown reads your own library from /v1/voices once the key is stored). pcm_24000 keeps time-to-first-audio low and is what makes the pace meter meaningful, but ElevenLabs gates PCM output above its free tier — on a free key the request comes back 401 with that reason, which the Test voice button prints verbatim.
